name: Holy Ice Weapon
summary: Create a temporary masterwork weapon that deals cold and holy-water damage.
description: Choose a simple weapon or your deity’s favored weapon. The resulting masterwork weapon deals ordinary weapon damage plus one point of cold damage per caster level (maximum 10). A creature vulnerable to holy water also takes 1d4 damage. The weapon melts if it leaves your hands for longer than one round. At caster level 6 it gains returning when thrown, reforming in your hand just before your next turn.
components: M (a flask of holy water, or 5 pounds of powdered silver worth 25 gp)
